name: RankMeRabbit – Data-Driven AI SEO
author: yoginetwork

sections.description:
Most SEO plugins hand you a list of problems and leave the fixing to you. RankMeRabbit fixes them and publishes the changes to your WordPress site.

RankMeRabbit’s AI analyzes your site, prepares recommended fixes, and publishes the changes you approve — no manual, page-by-page editing.

What it does for your site

  • Fixes on-page SEO automatically — optimized SEO titles, H1 headings, and missing image alt text, applied for you.
  • Builds smart internal links — contextually relevant internal links with natural anchor text that strengthen the pages that matter most.
  • Adds the right schema — schema optimization matched to each page type (Article, Product, FAQ, and more) so search engines understand your content.
  • Prioritizes with Search Console data — optionally connect Search Console to prioritize pages with the strongest SEO opportunities.
  • Includes an AI SEO assistant — ask questions about your site’s SEO right from your WordPress dashboard.

RankMeRabbit also finds broken links and orphan pages, maps your topical coverage, identifies content gaps, and surfaces relevant backlink opportunities across the sites you manage.

How it works

  1. Connect your WordPress site to your free RankMeRabbit account.
  2. RankMeRabbit audits your site and prepares the fixes.
  3. You review and approve what should change.
  4. Fixes publish automatically to your site, on a recurring schedule.

Works with your setup

Fixes apply correctly across the Block Editor (Gutenberg), Classic Editor, Elementor, Bricks, Beaver Builder, Oxygen, Divi 4, Divi 5, and Blocksy. RankMeRabbit also optimizes WooCommerce product pages and outputs product schema.

Who it’s for

  • Content creators and bloggers who want on-page SEO handled automatically.
  • SEO agencies and freelancers managing one large site or many client sites.
  • WooCommerce stores that need product SEO and schema at scale.

Free account

RankMeRabbit works together with the RankMeRabbit SEO platform, which prepares the fixes this plugin applies. Connect your RankMeRabbit account to get started. A free plan is available.

External services

This plugin connects to the RankMeRabbit SEO platform, an external service operated by Yogi Network, to receive the SEO fixes it applies to your site and to power its dashboard features. A RankMeRabbit account is required for the plugin to function.

What the plugin sends and when:

  • When you connect your site: your site domain and the connection keys (Status Key and Action Key) you copy from your RankMeRabbit dashboard are sent to https://api.rankmerabbit.com to verify the connection.
  • On a recurring sync (about every five minutes) and on manual sync: your site identifier and connection keys are sent to https://api.rankmerabbit.com to retrieve the latest prepared fixes (titles, headings, alt text, schema, internal links) so the plugin can apply them to your content.
  • When you use the built-in AI assistant: the message you type, along with your site domain and site identifier, is sent to https://api.rankmerabbit.com/api/plugin/chat to generate a response.

The plugin does not crawl your site itself; site crawling and analysis are performed by the RankMeRabbit platform. No content is sent to any third party other than the RankMeRabbit platform described above.

  • Service provider: Yogi Network / RankMeRabbit
  • Website: https://rankmerabbit.com/
  • Terms of Service: https://rankmerabbit.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://rankmerabbit.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install RankMeRabbit through the WordPress Plugins screen (Plugins → Add New → search for “RankMeRabbit”), or upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/rankmerabbit.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Create your free RankMeRabbit account at https://console.rankmerabbit.com.
  4. Add your site in the RankMeRabbit dashboard and copy your Status Key and Action Key.
  5. In WordPress, open the “RankMeRabbit” menu, paste your keys, and click Connect.
  6. RankMeRabbit begins applying prepared SEO fixes automatically. You can also trigger a sync manually at any time from the RankMeRabbit screen.
sections.faq:
Do I need a RankMeRabbit account?

Yes. This plugin is the WordPress companion to the RankMeRabbit SEO platform, which prepares the fixes the plugin applies. A free plan is available.

Is there a free version?

Yes. A free RankMeRabbit plan lets you connect your site and start applying fixes without paying.

Does this replace Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or All in One SEO?

RankMeRabbit can work alongside your existing SEO plugin. It specializes in preparing and applying SEO fixes — titles, headings, alt text, schema, and internal links — while existing SEO plugins can continue handling the features you already use. To avoid duplicate output (for example duplicate schema), review your settings so both plugins don’t manage the same element.

Which page builders are supported?

The Block Editor (Gutenberg), Classic Editor, Elementor, Bricks, Beaver Builder, Oxygen, Divi 4, Divi 5, and Blocksy. The plugin detects the builder on each page and applies fixes the correct way.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. RankMeRabbit optimizes WooCommerce product pages and can output product schema.

Does the plugin crawl my website?

No. Crawling and analysis are handled by the RankMeRabbit platform. The plugin receives the prepared fixes and applies them to your site.

How often are fixes applied?

Automatically, about every five minutes. You can also run a sync manually from the RankMeRabbit screen.

Will it change my content without my control?

The plugin applies the fixes you manage and approve on the RankMeRabbit platform. Internal-link application is enabled by default and can be managed from your settings. You can disconnect at any time from the RankMeRabbit screen, which stops all syncing.

How do I disconnect?

Open the RankMeRabbit menu in WordPress and choose Disconnect. This removes your stored keys and stops syncing.
